description: Named corpora. Analyses select runs and prompts by referencing an id here.
No analysis script may pattern-match directory names to decide membership.

_why: How observations are weighted WITHIN a run. Declaring this is as necessary
as declaring corpus membership: the published 45/49/80 in §4.3.1 treated every
level as an independent observation, so two long-running models supplied 60% of
the corpus from 6 of 18 runs and an unchanged sentence was counted once per
level. An analysis must name the aggregation it uses; the default is not obvious
and the paper has used three.

prompt.description: Every prompt is one observation. Runs are weighted by how long they ran.
prompt.note: Produced the original §4.3.1 rates. Rejected there — see decision A1a.

run_mean_fraction.description: Per run, the fraction of its prompts carrying the property; then the mean across runs. One vote per run, trajectory preserved.

run_final.description: One observation per run, the final committed prompt. Endpoint semantics.
run_final.note: Kept for §G: its dimensions are single-label typology, where an endpoint has clean meaning. Averaging them would have reversed §4.3.1's freedom-vs-improvement user-model contrast.

level_scopes.authored: every level except L0 (L0 is the empty starting prompt)
level_scopes.final: the highest committed level; for runs that converged at L1 this IS L1
level_scopes.l1_and_final: union of l1 and final, deduplicated per run

description: Every self-authored prompt in freedom mode. THE denominator for the
§4.3.1 theme and harm screens. The published figure of 196 came from a
corpus that also contained three runs of other models (gpt-5 x2,
grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning x1); over the 18 analysed runs it is 134.

improvement-authored.description: Every self-authored prompt in improvement mode.

happiness-authored.description: Every self-authored prompt in happiness mode.

all-authored.description: Every self-authored prompt, all modes. The §G classification corpus.

finals-54.description: The final committed prompt of each run; one observation per run.

happiness-finals.description: The 18 happiness finals. Input to the value/pain decomposition.

description: First and final committed prompt of all 54 runs. 102 rather than 108
because six runs converged at L1, where L1 is also the final.
Improvement-mode runs of the five models used in the blind audit.
Gemini-3 Pro is excluded: its base model was no longer served when the
audit ran, so no matched regeneration was possible.
